## Triage: first grade, `bug` · `priority:p3` · `domain:ui` · `area:studio` · `pm:queue` · triage seat · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-16T15:11Z

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015). ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Why p3:** machine names show where labels exist, on two Studio surfaces.
- **Lane:** `domain:ui`. Render through the metadata label, and fall back to the name only when no label exists.

Claim: PM loop round 7 (`priority:p3`; triage grade `6218511386`)
Session: `session_011K9g23W67dy2zwnyzaoB6o`
Account: `os-tesla`
Branch: `claude/issue-12693-studio-labels-over-names`
Worktree: `objectui-issue-12693` (in the cloud session's own container)
Domain: `domain:ui`
Seat: `domain:ui#1`
File surface: two Studio surfaces that show machine names where labels exist (the card's (a) and (b)).
- **(a) Explain access:** `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/AccessExplainPanel.tsx`, the Principal card's position and permission-set chips (near `:652` / `:662` at `main` `3288c12`) and the result banner's object name. The explain answer carries names only, so the panel resolves each label through the metadata the console already reads, and falls back to the name when there is no label.
- **(b) List-view Columns chips:** the Columns chips the Interfaces pillar's LIST VIEW properties draw (`packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/ObjectListViewInspector.tsx` and the chip renderer it uses, `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/FieldsListEditor.tsx`, if that is where the chip text is drawn): each chip reads the field's label, with the name kept reachable (for example as its `title`).
- tests beside them;
- one `.changeset/12693-*.md` for `@object-ui/app-shell`.

Outside the surface: the explain request and its server answer, the stored list-view `columns` (still field names), the other `FieldsListEditor` callers' behaviour beyond the chip text, and any new language-pack or dictionary key.

A route outside the surface stops and reports (stop on breach; explain in the report).
Container & model: `S`, `mode:cloud`, `model: opus` (default tier; no path-derived mandate)
Clause-②: no
Clause-② reason: chips and a banner draw labels where they drew names; no prop, export or key changes. If `FieldsListEditor` needs a new prop for the labels and it is exported from the package entry, line 2 becomes `Clause-②: yes` and the body says so.
Responsibility: Studio's access explainer and its list-view inspector (`@object-ui/app-shell`) | objectui#11862 (closed) fixed other Studio label surfaces; the explain answer carries names only, so the console resolves labels | every admin reading an access explanation or a list view's columns in Studio
Thread-read: 6218511386
Serial constraints cleared: read at objectui `main` `3288c12`. No open PR names `AccessExplainPanel.tsx`, `ObjectListViewInspector.tsx` or `FieldsListEditor.tsx` (every open PR's file list was read: #12818, #12828, #12830, #12831 and the bot PRs). In-flight `area:studio` work is disjoint: this seat's objectui#12780 (`flow-node-config`), objectui#12690 (`ResourceEditPage.tsx`, `metadata-admin/i18n.ts`, `RuntimeDraftBar.tsx`) and objectui#12691 (`ObjectValidationsPanel.tsx`), and seat-held objectui#12768 (the directory page).

Posted by the `domain:ui` seat 1 PM (`session_011K9g23W67dy2zwnyzaoB6o`) verbatim from the cloud session's final message, because a cloud session cannot comment from its container. The seat filled `pr` with the draft PR it opened, #12834.

**The seat's answers:**
- **Open question 1 (label source): A, the metadata lists' string labels.** It is the read the Access pillar already makes, once per run and only when needed; no second resolver.
- **Open question 2 (shared editor): A.** Only the row text and a `title` change, so every Columns list reads the same; `ViewColumnPanes.tsx` (`FieldListRow`) is the chip renderer the claim names.
- **Open question 3 (unscoped mount): A, leave it.** Studio always mounts the panel with a `packageId`.
- **The "Contributed by" chips finding** is recorded, not filed: it is the same family and a measured public-door reach, but the seat is signing off at the maintainer's word and names it in the sign-off ledger for the next seat or triage to card.
- **The seat read the diff** at `bfc7f7c`: 6 files, +380/−10. `lookUpItemLabels` lists a type only when a cited name is unlabelled and keeps string labels only; the banner reads `objectOptions`; `FieldsListEditor` prefers a column's own label, then the catalog label, then the name. The stored `columns` and the explain request are unchanged. `Clause-②: no` stands.
- **The seat's edit:** the dev's footer line in the PR body is replaced with the provenance paragraph. Next: CI on `bfc7f7c`, then the ACCEPT.
